requirement_text.REQ-420:
CI: add a path-filtered Mobile gate job to .github/workflows/ci.yml -- flutter analyze, flutter test, Android debug build -- for apps/mobile/**

.github/workflows/ci.yml has jobs `changes`, `backend` and `frontend` and no Flutter job (verified 2026-09-27). Without one, every MOB requirement after REQ-419 would merge with its tests unrun by CI. This requirement is sequenced immediately after REQ-419 and before REQ-421 (MOB-2 depends on it) so that CI exists before the second MOB requirement merges.
Owner MOBILE-DEV, by the REQ-138 precedent (FRONTEND-DEV added the frontend job): the job runs flutter, which only MOBILE-DEV's capability row covers. REQ-417 widens MOBILE-DEV's write scope to this job.

Read lib/letflow/design/iss0591-iss0592-ci-dedup-path-filter.md in full first; ci.yml's own header warns not to "simplify" its path-filter choices. Follow the existing pattern exactly:
1. `changes` job: add a `mobile` output. In the push branch (ISS-0840: push to main always runs every gate) and in both fail-safe branches (no usable base SHA, unreachable base SHA) and in the `fallback` step, emit mobile=true. In the diff branch, mobile is true iff a changed path matches ^(apps/mobile/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml). Do not change the backend/frontend regexes. Do not add mobile to path-filter-outputs.txt (cd.yml does not deploy mobile).
2. A new sibling job `mobile`, name "Mobile gate (flutter analyze + test + build)", runs-on ubuntu-latest, needs: changes, job-level `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` (NOT always(), NOT a job-level path condition -- same reasoning as backend/frontend), defaults working-directory apps/mobile. Steps: checkout; actions/setup-java (Temurin 17); subosito/flutter-action with flutter-version-file apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml and cache enabled; then, each with step-level `if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile != 'false'` (fail-open): `flutter pub get`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `flutter build apk --debug`.
3. No other job's keys change.

OPEN QUESTION (flagged, not resolved here): whether "Mobile gate (...)" becomes a third required status-check context on main per docs/migration/decisions/0018-branch-protection-posture.md. Changing branch protection is a 0018 amendment and belongs to REVIEWER/ORCH, not to this requirement. This requirement only makes the job eligible (always-runs, step-gated, so a required context would never be reported missing) and records the question in the job's header comment.

task.description: Produce the design artefact for REQ-420 (CI Mobile gate job) at lib/letflow/design/req420-ci-mobile-gate.md. This is a YAML/CI infra change, not lib/letflow/ or web/ code, so per code-designer.md's stated exception the design shows the literal target YAML: the exact new/changed lines in the `changes` job (push branch, both fail-safe branches, the fallback step, the new diff-branch mobile regex) and the complete new `mobile` job block verbatim (every step, its uses/run, its if condition, working-directory default), inside a fenced yaml block labeled as the target diff. Map every acceptance criterion to a concrete design element; flag open questions rather than guessing.
acceptance_criteria: `python -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml')); print(sorted(d['jobs'])); print(d['jobs']['mobile']['name']); print(d['jobs']['mobile']['if'])"` prints ['backend', 'changes', 'frontend', 'mobile'], the mobile job name, and ${{ !cancelled() }}, quoted

`git diff origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml` shows no removed or changed line inside the backend or frontend jobs and no change to the backend/frontend regexes -- only additions (the mobile output lines in `changes`, and the new job), quoted

every flutter step in the mobile job carries `if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile != 'false'`, and the `changes` job emits mobile=true on the push branch, both fail-safe branches and the fallback step -- verified by quoting the relevant lines

the PR that lands this requirement shows the Mobile gate job running all four flutter steps to success (the PR touches ci.yml, so the filter selects mobile) -- the Actions run URL and the four step conclusions quoted from `gh run view --json jobs`
a docs-only test PR or the same PR's job log shows the backend and frontend gates' conclusions unchanged by this edit (both still report success on this PR), quoted from `gh pr checks`
the job's header comment records the 0018 required-context question as open, quoted

result.summary: Produced lib/letflow/design/req420-ci-mobile-gate.md covering: (1) the exact changes-job edits -- new `mobile` output line, the added `echo "mobile=true"` line in the push branch and both fail-safe branches, the new diff-branch regex block `^(apps/mobile/|\.github/workflows/ci\.yml)` appended after the unchanged frontend regex, and the added `mobile=true` line in the fallback step -- each shown as a full before/after block so placement is unambiguous, with path-filter-outputs.txt explicitly left untouched per REQ-420's own instruction; (2) the complete verbatim new `jobs.mobile` block: name "Mobile gate (flutter analyze + test + build)", runs-on ubuntu-latest, needs: changes, job-level `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, defaults working-directory apps/mobile, steps actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-java@v4 (temurin 17), subosito/flutter-action@v2 (flutter-version-file: apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml, cache: true), then flutter pub get / flutter analyze / flutter test / flutter build apk --debug each gated `if: needs.changes.outputs.mobile != 'false'`; (3) a header comment on the new job recording the 0018 required-status-check open question verbatim, satisfying AC6; (4) confirmation that no backend/frontend job keys or regexes are touched (AC2). Verified apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml's environment.flutter: "3.41.7" line exists so flutter-version-file has a real target to read. AC4 and AC5 are live-CI verifications the implementer must run once this design is built and pushed -- flagged as not satisfiable at design time, not silently resolved. One open question flagged beyond the required 0018 one: whether `flutter pub get` should be split out as an unconditional step (mirroring backend's unconditional-setup/gated-run split) rather than grouped under the same fail-open condition as the other three flutter steps -- this design follows REQ-420's literal instruction (all four steps under one if) and flags the alternative for REVIEWER rather than silently choosing. No implementation code included -- only the target YAML itself, which is this design's own subject matter per the CI-YAML exception.
